articles.title: Odd Lots: The AI Trade Shrugs Off a Blue Wave and a Tech Scandal
articles.summary: It’s been a big month so far for American politics and the tech industry. Democrats deliver a sweeping win across the country, calling continued AI development into question. Nvidia launches an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy. There are plenty of things to make investors jittery, yet we’re seeing a tech rally as markets await the upcoming Anthropic IPO. Bloomberg’s Michael Ball joins Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway on the Odd Lots podcast to unpack why the tech trade is showing resilience despite macro jitters. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Lumentum Slips on Deal Reaction; Fossil Group Rallies on Outlook | Stock Movers
articles.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Shares of CoreWeave (CRWV) rallied in premarket trading after the compay eased fears about its debt-laden business during a high-stakes quarterly report, indicating that sales growth remains strong despite challenges facing the data center industry. The AI computing provider projected revenue of $13 billion to $13.3 billion this year. That exceeded its previous range of up to $13.2 billion and sailed past the $12.9 billion that Wall Street had predicted. - Shares of Lumentum Holdings (LITE) slipped ahead of the US market open. Marvell Technology’s (MRVL) plan to double down on AI through a blockbuster $115 billion acquisition of Lumentum is getting a lukewarm early verdict from investment experts who bet on deals. - Shares of Fossil Group (FOSL) rallied after the company raised its full-year sales outlook after posting quarterly growth sooner than expected. (Source: Bloomberg)
